sources.title: Target-Aware Calibration Data Selection for Preserving Uncertainty in ...
sources.snippet: Abstract Quantization is widely used to deploy large language models, but its effect on uncertainty behavior, such as confidence, margins, and abstention, is rarely treated as a primary objective. We frame calibration-data selection for quantization as a target-dependent uncertainty-preservation problem.
